description: This Swift source file defines the UI components and logic for an onboarding wizard in an iOS application. It manages multiple onboarding steps including introductory screens, gateway connection (via QR code or manual setup), authentication, and success confirmation. It includes state management, user interaction handling, QR code scanning, and external link parsing, tailored for establishing a connection with a gateway device within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: An enumeration representing the various steps in the onboarding process, including intro, welcome, mode selection, connection, authentication, and success screens.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View struct implementing the onboarding wizard UI, handling user interactions, state management, QR code scanning, and connection logic.

classes.name: OnboardingModeRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI View component representing a selectable row for different onboarding connection modes.

methods.name: handleScannedLink
methods.description: Processes a scanned QR code link to extract connection parameters and initiates a manual connection.

methods.name: openQRScannerFromOnboarding
methods.description: Prepares the app state and opens the QR code scanner for onboarding.

methods.name: resumeAfterPairingApproval
methods.description: Resumes connection attempts after user approval during pairing.

methods.name: attemptAutomaticPairingResumeIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically attempts to resume pairing process if conditions are met, respecting a rate limit.

methods.name: detectQRCode
methods.description: Detects and extracts a QR code message string from image data.

methods.name: advanceFromIntro
methods.description: Transitions from the intro step to the next onboarding step.

methods.name: navigateBack
methods.description: Navigates back to the previous onboarding step if available.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a discovered gateway asynchronously.

methods.name: selectMode
methods.description: Selects a connection mode and applies default settings.

methods.name: applyModeDefaults
methods.description: Sets default connection parameters based on the selected mode.

methods.name: gatewayHasResolvableHost
methods.description: Determines if a discovered gateway has a resolvable LAN or DNS host.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a manual host and port asynchronously.

methods.name: retryLastAttempt
methods.description: Retries the last connection attempt, optionally silently.

methods.name: initializeState
methods.description: Initializes onboarding state from saved settings or defaults.

methods.name: scheduleDiscoveryRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the gateway discovery process with a slight delay.

methods.name: saveGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Saves the gateway token and password to persistent storage.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Saves a bootstrap token for gateway connection.
